# c — frozen question (do not edit; hash recorded in z.md)

For an integer H >= 1 find an explicit X(H) and prove, without L-functions, Siegel zeros, GRH, QRH,
Heegner/Baker/Stark or class-number tables:

    every imaginary quadratic field K with |disc K| = D >= X(H) has h(K) > H,

by Green's derivative Gram determinant on the lattice points of O_K in a disc |z| <= rho, Frobenius
divisibility at inert primes, an explicit count of split primes using all h reduced forms, Hadamard,
and Dusart 2010 (theta(x) >= x(1-0.2/ln^2 x), x >= 3 594 641). Below X(H): direct computation.
